integrity: Exact normalized power-difference norm, continuum of cluster intervals, and inverse identification of spectral spacing are analytically proved; no claim of independent validation or certification.
scientific_limitations: Classification applies to complex-Hilbert-space diagonal normal contractions with spectrum on one fixed ray, positive strictly decreasing spectral deficits, and a limiting successive-deficit ratio.
No extension asserted to nonnormal operators or to sequences without an asymptotic ratio.
Finite numerical diagnostics supplement, but do not establish, the general theorem.
Publication priority is subject to independent verification.
title: Inverse spectral-spacing law for normalized Ritt power differences
